body:
Oncall Bot: :rotating_light: Pager: spike of 429s and queue growth for /v1/generate in eu-west-1 (avg 429 rate ~18%). Auto-escalating to oncall.

Sam K: I'm on it. seeing lots of queued requests on gpu-hotpath (queue length ~14k). latency 95p ~6.2s.

Maria G: Looking at autoscaler logs — scale decisions are being throttled by a rateband check. autoscaler attempted to add nodes but hit org max_pool_size.

Lee S: Confirmed: autoscaler CPU/GPUs not the limiter, it's the allocation policy: tiered token bucket prevented burst allocation to hotpool because regen_rate was too conservative.

Ana P: Any customer-facing impact? Which customers hit errors?

Oncall Bot: Top impacted tenants: acme-inc (errored requests 7.4k), playground (dev) has many 429s, a small number of enterprise customers seeing elevated latency but not full errors.

Sam K: Quick mitigation options: 1) increase pool quota (requires infra approval), 2) relax tokenbucket regen and burst units for eu-west hotpool, 3) route non-critical traffic to cheaper model variant, 4) toggle fallback to CPU-backed pool.

Maria G: I can change tokenbucket on the hotpath-ratelimit to increase burst_units and regen_rate. But note policy is shared across tiers — we need care.

Lee S: Can we do an emergency canary: temporarily lower the tier floor so hotpool can accept more burst? That avoids touching org quota.

Sam K: Trying the route-change first to stop new pressure. Deploy Bot: initiating route change to send 20% of prod traffic for low-priority keys to model-redwood-small in eu-west-1.

Deploy Bot: Route change applied: route weights updated. Monitoring.

Oncall Bot: Route change reduced incoming hotpath load by ~18% after 90s. 429 rate down to 12%. Queue length trending down to ~9k.

Ana P: Good. Customers still seeing some 429s — can we batch more aggressively for the smaller model?

Maria G: Batching config is already maxed for that pool. Next step: adjust tokenbucket on hotpool to allow temporary higher burst. Requesting perms to patch policy.

Lee S: Heads-up — increasing bucket burst without regen adjustments could cause downstream fairness issues between tenants. We should scope to eu-west hotpool only.

Sam K: I will patch the tokenbucket policy scoped to pool "eu-west-hotpath" and increase burst_units from 1000 -> 4000 and regen_rate from 50/s -> 200/s for 30m. Applying now.

Maria G: Patch applied. Logs: 
```
PATCH /config/tokenbuckets/eu-west-hotpath
{ "burst_units": 4000, "regen_per_sec": 200, "expires_in": "30m" }
```

Oncall Bot: After tokenbucket tweak: 429 rate dropped to 4.7% in 2m. Latency 95p down to 4.1s. Queue length ~2.1k.

Sam K: Autoscaler still unable to add more nodes due to org quota. I opened an infra ticket to raise pool cap, pinging Infra Bot.

Infra Bot: infra ticket #INF-5421 created: "emergency increase eu-west hotpool max nodes by +8". Noted impact and request for fast track.

Lee S: While we wait on quota, we should ensure ratepolicy rollback procedures are in place. If regen spikes lead to burst stealing, revert the patch.

Maria G: Adding a watch script to revert tokenbucket after 30m and to lower if we see fairness signal: tenant-latency-delta > 30%.

Sam K: Noted. Also enabling fallback to cpu-pool for long tail requests: setting max_total_tokens_per_request threshold to push large seqs to cpu-pool.

Deploy Bot: Fallback rule applied. Monitoring cold starts for CPU pool. Warm-up looks OK.

Oncall Bot: Customer-impact summary for SOC: acme-inc saw 7.4k failed requests, approx 2.3% of daily traffic during the surge window. Business workaround: they received retries from client. No data loss.

Ana P: Thanks. We'll prepare a short incident note: cause = tokenbucket regen too low + autoscaler quota cap; mitigation = route-weighting, tokenbucket temporary bump, enable CPU fallback, infra quota request.

Sam K: Postmortem action items: 1) Increase default regen for hotpools during rollout windows. 2) Add guardrail so autoscaler can request emergency ephemeral capacity even if org max reached (with audit). 3) Split tokenbucket policies per-tenant for enterprise keys. 4) Improve observability: expose tokenbucket refill rate metric in console.

Lee S: Agree. Also add a runbook step: "If queue > 10k and 429% > 10% then route 20% traffic away and bump tokens temporarily."

Maria G: Captured. I'll schedule the follow-ups.

Oncall Bot: Incident resolved. 429s stabilized to <1% after infra patch (quota increase) landed at +8 nodes (INF-5421). Reverting tokenbucket to baseline in 5.

Sam K: Revert complete. Monitoring steady.

Ana P: Great job team. I'll draft customer comms and link to the postmortem. :thumbsup:

Oncall Bot: wrap-up: timeline logged, mitigations and follow-ups added to incident tracker.

Sam K: closing thread, moving to postmortem lane. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
